description: Index of the adventure roll tables. The server hashes the exact bytes of every file listed here, in listed order, as the tables revision.

rng.init: state = finalize(seed + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15), where finalize is the two-multiply xor-shift mix below applied once, so adjacent seeds give unrelated streams
rng.next: state = state + 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 (mod 2^64); z = state; z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EB; return z ^ (z >> 31)  (all mod 2^64)
rng.roll: roll(N): limit = 2^64 - (2^64 mod N); draw x until x < limit; natural = (x mod N) + 1

selection.faces: Entries own contiguous face ranges covering 1..die exactly; a list of n entries uses the smallest die in {4,6,8,10,12,20} with n <= die, faces spread evenly with the first (die mod n) entries taking one extra face. Lists of 1 are not rolled.
selection.incompatible: If the entry is incompatible with earlier results, record the roll as rejected and roll the same die again.
selection.fallback: After 64 rejections take the first compatible entry in table order and record it as 'fallback' (natural 0).
selection.determinism: Every draw, including rejected ones, consumes the stream, so the whole adventure is a pure function of (seed, tables revision, rules mode).

rules_modes.custom_allowed: All twelve; any simplified antagonist makes the run a disclosed custom ruleset.

roll_order.filter: antagonist.fits intersects location.tags AND (fidelity == exact OR rules_mode == custom_allowed)
location sub-table; matching depicted art and a compatible contact (including forced campaign contact)
contact fits location and destination kind is in places.contact_destinations
contact given != patron given; contact surname != patron surname; person antagonist given not in {patron, contact}

roll_order.table: trait.patron.mannerism, trait.patron.speech, trait.contact.mannerism, trait.contact.speech, trait.antagonist.menace (speakers only)

roll_order.filter: b != a; c not in {a, b}
patron meeting place and location confrontation

roll_order.die: 4 (2-variant lists use d4 with two faces each)
roll_order.filter: antagonist group selects combat_open_* and foreshadow_*; hook.kind selects route_* and defeat_*

campaign.stream: Campaign frame rolls use a separate stream: Rng(seed XOR 0xCA3DA16B5EED). The frame is rolled once.
frame_roll_order: site.first-clue / lieutenant-lair / stronghold / extra roles d8 without repeats (soft role preference)
faction d12 + attitude d6 + attitude-to-villain d6 (each)
campaign.chapter_seed: chapter_seed(n, outcome_digest) = finalize(campaign_seed + n * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 + finalize(outcome_digest)); outcome_digest is SHA-256 (first 8 bytes) of the canonical outcome record of chapter n-1.
campaign.chapter_generation: The chapter reuses the adventure roll order with forced entries: location from the slot role, hook kind and stake tags from the chapter type, patron and contact from the recurring cast, antagonist from the villain's minions or the named lieutenant, clue texts for the secret, recap and contact lines; every forced value is recorded with status 'forced'.
